- K2 Residents: on the demo the tab says "This server does not serve the residents read yet, so nothing is stated here about who holds or lives in this building." A served read that answers 404 says "The server holds no register extract for this building."; a failed read says "The residents of this building could not be read · <code>"; a pending read shows a skeleton (register/registerState.ts residentsStatement, 4 tests).
